title: Branchless LZ77 Decoder
relevance: Original description of branchless LZ77 decoding technique: unify literal and copy operations using conditional pointer selection.

title: Improved Branch Prediction for Just-in-Time Decompression of Canonical Huffman Bytecode Streams
relevance: Identifies indirect branches as a major performance bottleneck in Huffman decompression and proposes improved branch prediction for JIT decompression.

title: Fast Huffman decoding by exploiting data level parallelism
relevance: Explores data-level parallelism for Huffman decoding, a complementary technique to branch elimination.
